10. The one who plays Carrom lives immediately above the one who plays Kabaddi.
11. Q lives on the floor immediately above the floor of O.
12. Neither the one who plays Football nor N lives in flat B.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Floor and flat puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight persons — Aarav, Geeta, Heena, Nikhil, Omkar, Priya, Rekha and Yamini — live in a four-storey building. Each floor has two flats: flat P and flat Q. Flat P is to the west of flat Q. Flat P of floor 2 is immediately above flat P of floor 1 and immediately below flat P of floor 3, and so on; the same holds for flat Q. The lowermost floor is numbered 1 and the topmost floor is numbered 4. Exactly one person lives in each flat. Each of them likes a different flower — Tulip, Lily, Orchid, Sunflower, Rose, Marigold, Daisy and Lotus.

1. Yamini lives to the west of Priya.
2. Heena and the one who likes Daisy live in different types of flats.
3. Nikhil lives on a floor above the floor of the one who likes Tulip.
4. Only one floor is between the floors of Omkar and the one who likes Lily.
5. Yamini lives in the same type of flat as Rekha.
6. The one who likes Orchid lives immediately above Geeta.
7. Omkar lives on the floor immediately above the floor of the one who likes Marigold.
8. Heena and the one who likes Sunflower live in different types of flats.
9. The one who likes Rose does not live on floor 2.
10. The one who likes Rose lives immediately below Geeta.
11. Aarav lives to the east of Geeta.
12. The one who likes Marigold does not live on an even-numbered floor.
13. Rekha likes Daisy.
